# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability privately

Use **[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/raffribeiro/ColorAtlas/security/advisories/new)** for suspected security vulnerabilities in Color Atlas.

Please do not post exploit details, sensitive files or credentials in a public issue.

Include:

- The affected app version or URL and your browser/operating system.
- A description of the impact and the steps needed to reproduce it.
- A minimal sample or proof of concept with personal information removed.
- Any relevant error message or screenshot, after removing sensitive data.

Please use your own test data and avoid disrupting the public site or other users' work.

## Scope

Color Atlas is a browser app distributed through GitHub Pages and an offline HTML package. Reports may cover the app, file imports, embedded editor messaging and the published distribution. Include the version when reporting an offline package; use the latest published version when checking whether an issue still occurs.

For ordinary bugs and feature requests, use the repository's [issue templates](https://github.com/raffribeiro/ColorAtlas/issues/new/choose).
